The financing could include a roughly $30 ​billion junior debt tranche, while the chip designer would guarantee a part of a senior-secured tranche that could range from about $60 billion to $70 billion, the report said.  Broadcom plays a crucial role in helping design custom chips for firms like Alphabet and Meta, as tech companies ⁠look to develop chips in-house to reduce their reliance on market leader Nvidia.
